title: Decision-Driven Regularization: A Blended Model for Learning and Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.15124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In contextual optimization, the decision-maker seeks optimal decisions to minimize a cost function, that varies based on observed features. This context is common in many business applications ranging from on-demand delivery and retail operations to portfolio optimization and inventory management. In this paper, we study the learning and optimization approach, which first learns how outcomes result from the features, and then selects optimal decisions based on these outcomes. We focus on the integrated learning and optimization literature, and identify that a lack of control for prediction accuracy can lead to overfitting and a loss of decision effectiveness against simple separate learning and optimization models. Instead, we propose a bi-objective formulation that balances prediction accuracy and cost minimization, termed decision-driven regularization. It also addresses ambiguity in the definition of the cost function via a surrogate

translated_title: 决策驱动的正则化：学习与优化的混合模型
translated_abstract: 在上下文优化中，决策者寻求最优决策以最小化成本函数，该函数根据观察到的特征而变化。这种情境在许多商业应用中很常见，从按需配送和零售运营到投资组合优化和库存管理。在本文中，我们研究了学习与优化方法，该方法首先学习结果如何由特征产生，然后基于这些结果选择最优决策。我们专注于集成学习与优化的文献，并指出缺乏对预测准确性的控制可能导致过拟合，以及相对于简单的分离式学习与优化模型，决策有效性的丧失。相反，我们提出了一种双目标公式，平衡预测准确性和成本最小化，称为决策驱动的正则化。它还通过代理函数解决了成本函数定义中的模糊性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种决策驱动的正则化双目标方法，在集成学习与优化中平衡预测准确性和成本最小化，以避免过拟合并提高决策有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-driven regularization bi-objective approach that balances prediction accuracy and cost minimization in integrated learning and optimization to avoid overfitting and enhance decision effectiveness.
